In-place mutual rank transformation

Source: R/RcppExports.R
mutual_rank_inplace_cpp.Rd

Overwrites sim with its mutual rank transform without allocating any n x n temporaries. Pass 1 clamps each column to [-1, 1], optionally takes absolute values, and replaces the column by its average ranks. Pass 2 replaces each pair (i, j) by sqrt(R_ij * R_ji) (log-normalized when log_transform) and sets the diagonal to 0. Same formulas and tie handling as mutual_rank_transform_cached_cpp(), which is kept as the reference implementation.

mutual_rank_inplace_cpp(sim, log_transform, abs_cor, n_cores)

Arguments

sim

Symmetric correlation/similarity matrix (n x n). Modified in place: must be a fresh allocation not shared with any other R object, and must be stored as double (REALSXP); any other storage type is an error, since coercion would silently operate on a copy. Must not contain NaN/NA (ranking would be undefined); an error is raised and the contents of sim are then unspecified.

log_transform

If FALSE, raw mutual rank with ascending ranks (original Rmd formula). If TRUE, Obayashi & Kinoshita (2009) log-normalized formula with descending ranks (values in 0 to 1 range).

abs_cor

If TRUE, take absolute values before ranking.

n_cores

Number of OpenMP threads

Value

Invisible NULL; sim is modified in place.
